summary: Frontend-only Playwright regression on OFF THE SADDLE film-reel exhibition (iteration 2 features). All 13 requested flows verified end-to-end via public URL at 1920x800. Header shows 'CHRONICLE', 8 object cards render, chronicle-pager renders [01..08] with active state, hover reveals big serif name + metadata, product modal opens from card, NEXT/PREV buttons and ArrowLeft/Right keys cycle products inside modal (Ember -> Fault Line -> Kiln Drops -> Fault Line), Add to bag transitions to 'Added to bag' and increments header count to 01, Escape closes modal cleanly (returns to exhibition, no blank state), bag drawer slides open with correct item, total ₹24,000 matches Fault Line Neckpiece price, Remove empties list and disables Checkout, bag-empty message shown, bag close button + backdrop click both close drawer, ArrowRight with exhibition in focus advances active pager, Menu overlay first link reads 'Chronicle'. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductView.close(): if sourceEl is stale/detached (e.g., after cyclic navigation to an object that hasn't been mounted in DOM yet), sourceTransform() would throw. In practice App.navigate re-queries [data-object-id] so it works, but a null-guard around sourceEl.getBoundingClientRect would harden it.
ProductView keydown listener has [onNavigate] dep but eslint-disable exhaustive-deps is on; close() references stale closingRef/onExitStart via closure — currently fine but noteworthy.
BagDrawer renders backdrop even when closed (pointer-events likely off via CSS). Confirm bag__backdrop has pointer-events:none when not is-open to avoid intercepting clicks on exhibition.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL https://saddle-menu-overlay.preview.emergentagent.com. Custom cursor requires force=True on all clicks. Cards use data-testid=object-card-<id>. Modal cyclic navigation verified. Bag drawer uses .is-open class for open state; check that when asserting. Product prices: Ember 6800, Fault Line 24000, Kiln 3400, Bastar 5200, Rann 4600, Anvil 12500, Smoke Glass 7900, Tendril 3900.
